notes.title: Reverie Knights Tactics Full Version Livestream With Jared and Lead Developer
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers,
We will be live-streaming the full version of the game today, January 20 at 19:00 CET (13:00 EST, 10:00 PST) on our twitch channel. You will not only  be among the first to see the full game, but you will also meet the lead developer - producer, director and illustrator of Reverie Knights Tactics, EdH Müller, who will talk in-depth about the game's development journey.

The stream will be hosted and commented by Jared, so you know it's gonna be fun. Don't miss the chance to hang out with the lead developer and be among the first to see the full game, don't forget to set a reminder!

The game will be available from January 25, so don't forget to wishlist it now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399690/Reverie_Knights_Tactics/

notes.title: Reverie Knights Tactics' Release Date is Announced!
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers,

Mark your calendars, for the day we embark on our epic quest to save the lost expedition to Lennórien is finally known! Our perilous journey will begin on January 25th, 2022 - so rest well this holiday season, and gather your strength - you will surely need it to face the goblinoid hordes wreaking havoc across the continent!

To mark this momentous occasion, we have prepared a new trailer:

[previewyoutube=Sl2d5SYCXUs;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope to see you in-game very soon. For now, feel free to leave us a message on our discussion boards, join our discord server or, of course, get the first taste of the game by playing the free Prologue that is already available!

Don't forget to wishlist Reverie Knights Tactics:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399690/Reverie_Knights_Tactics/

notes.title: Reverie Knights Tactics: Prologue patch is now live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883080/fabb1afaee1002b07baa1e2fa94d9d7071648659.jpg

Greetings adventurers! We have prepared an update, that address the technical issues that our fans have mentioned in the Steam Forums and the reviews. We would like to thank all of you, who provided us with feedback and we hope that you can now properly enjoy the Prologue!

You can read the full changelog below:
Fixes:

 Fixed some Localization typos.
 Fixed an issue where the arrows indicating the push/pull direction of skills would be visible in units that could not be moved.
 Fixed an issue where the Customization Screen could become unresponsive to changing Units when menus would be opened and closed in certain orders.
 Fixed an issue where a turn could be ended before selecting the facing direction for a Unit, preventing the battle from progressing.
 Fixed an issue where in rare instances, the Items Window would not be displayed during a battle when selecting the Consumables Button.
 Fixed a visual issue in the Glossary Entries not updating the selected/hovered state for buttons when changing tabs using a controller.
 Fixed a visual issue where the look direction arrows would remain visible for the scene transition when retrying a battle.
 Fixed a visual issue related to the Quick Unit Selection Portraits on the Battle Screen displaying a Unit no longer in the party when loading a save without said character in the party.
 Moved the Unit portraits in the Battle Screen to give more room for Unit names in different languages.
 Fixed an issue where after loading a game through the Pause Menu, the Pause Menu would be closed instantly once when pausing the game using a controller.
 Fixed an issue where a Screen would not respond to the first input made on a controller.
 Fixed an issue where the Label "Stock" would not be displayed properly in certain languages in the Crafter Screen.
 Fixed an issue where Left and Right triggers on a console would not display the active and selected Unit status effects in the Battle Screen.
 Added a Skip functionality to the Opening Text for the prologue.
 Adjusted the volume for certain ambient sounds.
